player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko {color} wɔ Breakthrough agorɔ mu. Wo tu {direction} wɔ {board_size}x{board_size} agorɔpono so.
Wɔ wo bere mu, wo betumi atu agorɔ mu biako kɔ n'anim kɔnɔ, anaasɛ wɔ n'anim kɔnɔ, wɔ ɛkwan a ɛyɛ mũ no.
Agorɔ mu biako betumi atu wɔ n'anim kɔnɔ ɛkwan a ɛyɛ mũ no sɛ ɔpɔnfoɔ agorɔ mu biako wɔ hɔ, na ɛno nko ara ne bere a wo betumi atu wɔ ɛkwan a ɛyɛ mũ no.
Wo bere a wo tu kɔ agorɔ mu biako a ɔpɔnfoɔ agorɔ mu biako wɔ mu, wo fa mu, na ɔpɔnfoɔ agorɔ mu biako no kɔ awieeɛ.
Fa UCI-te sɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛte sɛ [a2a3] de tu fi a2 kɔ a3.
* 'a' kɔrɛsɛpɔn column a ɛwɔ benkum, '1' yɛ row a ɛwɔ ase (fi White hɔ).
* Black home row yɛ row a ɛwɔ soro (row 8 ma 8x8). White home row yɛ row a ɛwɔ ase (row 1 ma 8x8).
Ogyefoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔpɛ agorɔ mu biako du ɔpɔnfoɔ home row no, ɔno na ɔdi nkunim. Sɛ wo agorɔ mu biako nyinaa fa wɔ mu a, wo di nkoguo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yɛsrɛ sɛ fa abodin a ɛwɔ bracket mu te sɛ [a2a3].
invalid_move.illegal: Saa a wobɛyɛ no nni Apɔwmu Nhyehyɛe mmara so anaa ɛnyɛ wo de.

outcome.white_captured: White agorɔ mu biako nyinaa fa wɔ mu.
